[
  {"task_id":"ctx-k7-3","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and zero-based coordinates modulo 3. Zeros on row residue 0 become 8 at column residues 1 and 2; zeros on row residue 2 become 2 at column residue 1 and 5 at residue 2. Demonstration 6 shows both repeating sequences; other pixels retain their colours."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k1-1","params":{"keysel":[0,9,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and the row's nonzero colour set. For set {2}, zeros become 2, as in demonstration 1's fourth row. For {2,3}, colour 3 becomes 4, as in demonstration 8's second row. For {1,2,3}, zeros become 6 and colour 3 becomes 8, as in demonstration 2's fourth row."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k1-2","params":{"keysel":[0,9,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and the row's nonzero colour set. Zeros become 4 for {1,2}, illustrated by demonstration 1's first row; zeros become 7 for {2} or {1,3}, illustrated by demonstration 4's fourth and first rows. Colour 3 becomes 0 for {1,2,3}, as in demonstration 1's second and fourth rows."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k4-2","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,0,9,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and coordinate parity. On even rows, odd-column zeros become 4 and twos become 1; even-column threes become 0. On odd rows, even-column twos become 4. Demonstration 1 exhibits all four changes; remaining parity-colour combinations stay unchanged."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k4-0","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,0,9,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and coordinate parity. Even-row odd-column zeros become 2; even-row even-column threes become 1. Odd-row even-column zeros become 9 and twos become 6. Demonstration 1 shows each mapping, including 2 to 6 at row 1, column 2."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k6-2","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,0,0,0,9,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and nearest nonzero colours in the four cardinal directions. Demonstration 1 changes row 1, columns 2 and 3 from 0 to 6; demonstration 4 changes row 5, column 3 from 0 to 1. These directional context keys distinguish the sparse changes from unchanged zeros."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k3-2","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,9,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and both row and column nonzero sets. In demonstration 1, ones become 6 where both sets are {1,2,3}. In demonstration 5, zeros become 6 for row set {1,3} and empty column set; its row 3, column 0 changes 2 to 3 for row set {1,2,3} and column set {2,3}."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k6-0","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,0,0,0,9,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and nearest nonzero cardinal colours. Demonstration 6's top-right zero has nearest colours 2 below and 2 left, with no colour above or right, and becomes 6. Demonstration 8's row 2, column 0 zero sees 2 above, 1 below and 3 right, with none left, and becomes 8."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k7-2","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and coordinates modulo 3. On row residue 2, zeros become 7, 9 and 1 at column residues 0, 1 and 2 respectively; demonstration 3's empty third row shows the repeating sequence. On row residue 1, column residue 1, zeros become 3. Other keys preserve their colours."},
  {"task_id":"ctx-k4-1","params":{"keysel":[0,0,0,0,9,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Use own colour and coordinate parity. On even rows, all twos become 0 and even-column ones become 9. On odd rows, odd-column zeros become 1. Demonstration 1 shows these changes in rows 2, 3, 4 and 5; other parity-colour combinations remain unchanged."}
]
